notes:
Summary: multinational financial services platform exploring Redwood Private (VPC) for production LLM workloads focused on strict data residency and regional controls. Primary ask: EU-only data residency for EU customers, separate UK tenancy, Canada and APAC availability later.

Discovery highlights:
- 2026-01-14 kickoff call w/ Jordan (AE), Priya (SE). They operate core banking & KYC pipelines; heavy compliance requirements.
- 2026-01-28 architecture deep-dive w/ Priya; asked about control plane placement (must be customer-managed or private control plane in EU).
- 2026-02-05 security review w/ security team (Fireflies ff_2026-02-05_0192). Main concerns: BYOK/KMS, HSM, audit chain, long-term retention of logs.

Use-case / workload notes:
- Primary: customer-support bot (chat) + document search over legal/transactional docs; also periodic reranking for compliance triage.
- Scale target for POC: ~100–200 RPS embedding/rerank mix, chat p95 latency target <250ms for short-turn generation.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — procurement expects clear unit economics and Optimize recommendations to hit ARR targets.

Security / compliance requirements (copied from customer):
- EU-only data residency for EU customers; separate logical tenancy for UK (UK-specific residency/regulatory nuance).
- Canada: requires option to store data in Canada region for CA customers. APAC: lower priority, wants region controls later.
- KMS: must support BYOK (AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault options) and HSM-backed keys. Key rotation policy and customer-controlled key revocation required.
- Audit logging: full invocation logs (token counts, model id, request metadata) forwarded to their SIEM (S3 + Kafka + Splunk connector). Retention: 7 years for transaction-related logs.
- Network: VPC peering / PrivateLink only; no public internet egress for inference traffic.
- Identity: SSO (SAML) + SCIM for user provision; role-based access controls and per-team usage quotas.
- Certifications required: SOC2 + ISO27001; prefer evidence of external pen test report.

POC ask / scope:
- 4-week EU-only POC in frankfurt (eu-central) with private VPC and private control plane option.
- Deliverables: architecture diagram, KMS BYOK test, audit log pipeline to customer's S3, latency and throughput benchmarks for their sample workload, cost estimate and Optimize recommendations.
- Success criteria: data residency validated (no data egress out of EU), KMS integration tested end-to-end, p95 latency <250ms for chat baseline, pass security checklist items marked critical.

Commercial / legal notes:
- Procurement: will push through enterprise purchasing in Q2; legal wants DPA with explicit EU residency clause and Subprocessor list.
- Estimated ARR: ~$250k–$600k; high upside if Dedicated reserved capacity included.

- 2025-11-18 exploratory call; indicated strong preference for private deployment.
- 2026-01-14 product intro + demo.

Open actions (short):
